definitions.IN_FORCE: Binding regime currently applicable within the stated scope.
definitions.ENACTED_NOT_YET_EFFECTIVE: Law has been enacted but substantive effective date has not yet arrived.
definitions.FINAL_RULES_NOT_YET_EFFECTIVE: Final implementing rules are published but commence on a future date.
definitions.IMPLEMENTATION_RULEMAKING: Binding statute/policy exists but implementing regulations are still being made.
definitions.CONSULTATION: Proposal is open/closed for comment and is not yet a binding final rule.
definitions.RESTRICTIVE_PROHIBITIVE: The jurisdiction does not offer a normal authorisation path for the activity within the stated scope.
definitions.GUIDANCE_ONLY: Supervisory guidance/expectation without a standalone dedicated binding regime.

hard_rule: Do not infer IN_FORCE from the existence of an enacted law, final policy design, consultation conclusion, licence application, pilot, or register.
